decks.module: Night, work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Night driving reduces the distance you can see.
cards.back: Night driving reduces the distance you can see, so search ahead and along both pavement edges.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use high beams when there is no oncoming.
cards.back: Use high beams when there is no oncoming traffic, and dim them for an approaching vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: If an approaching driver leaves bright headlights on, look.
cards.back: If an approaching driver leaves bright headlights on, look toward the roadway’s right edge instead of staring at the lights.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use low beams when following another.
cards.back: Use low beams when following another vehicle and in fog, rain or snow.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep scanning around the vehicle and beyond.
cards.back: Keep scanning around the vehicle and beyond the lit area for dark objects or shapes.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid sunglasses and colored lenses at night or.
cards.back: Avoid sunglasses and colored lenses at night or on cloudy days because they reduce available light.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: At night, the manual advises adding at.
cards.back: At night, the manual advises adding at least one second to the following gap.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: For unfamiliar roads at night, the manual.
cards.back: For unfamiliar roads at night, the manual specifies an addition of at least two seconds.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: A work zone can include closed lanes, detours.
cards.back: A work zone can include closed lanes, detours and heavy equipment near or on the road.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow through a work zone even when workers are.
cards.back: Slow through a work zone even when workers are absent because narrowed lanes and uneven pavement remain hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch work-zone signs, cones.
cards.back: Watch work-zone signs, cones, drums, large vehicles and people.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flashing or sequencing arrow panel can announce a.
cards.back: A flashing or sequencing arrow panel can announce a lane closure; slow and move toward the indicated open lane.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Construction warning signs generally show black text.
cards.back: Construction warning signs generally show black text or symbols on orange and are often diamond-shaped.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Barricades, vertical panels, concrete barriers, drums.
cards.back: Barricades, vertical panels, concrete barriers, drums and cones guide drivers through construction areas.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Near channeling devices, keep the vehicle centered.
cards.back: Near channeling devices, keep the vehicle centered in its lane and use a responsible speed.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: On leaving a work zone, hold your lane and.
cards.back: On leaving a work zone, hold your lane and speed and wait until fully clear before changing lanes.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Flaggers use high-visibility clothing, paddles, flags and hand.
cards.back: Flaggers use high-visibility clothing, paddles, flags and hand signals to direct traffic; follow their signals patiently.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: In a work zone, lower speed, enlarge.
cards.back: In a work zone, lower speed, enlarge the following gap and remain ready to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep clear of workers and construction vehicles and use.
cards.back: Keep clear of workers and construction vehicles and use extra caution at night even when workers are absent.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Continue following work-zone controls until.
cards.back: Continue following work-zone controls until the End Road Work sign.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Plan for construction delays, leave early.
cards.back: Plan for construction delays, leave early and choose another route when possible.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: On dirt or gravel, slow and increase.
cards.back: On dirt or gravel, slow and increase the following gap because tire grip is reduced.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: On narrow rural roads, slow, stay centered in.
cards.back: On narrow rural roads, slow, stay centered in your lane and watch for oncoming vehicles crowding it.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: The single-lane bridge guidance gives the first.
cards.back: The single-lane bridge guidance gives the first arriving driver priority and calls for taking turns.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: For an open-grating or steel bridge, reduce speed.
cards.back: For an open-grating or steel bridge, reduce speed, increase the gap ahead and hold the wheel firmly.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: Where woods, crops or hills block.
cards.back: Where woods, crops or hills block the view, slow and prepare to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: How should a driver approach a rural intersection without signals or stop slash yield signs?
cards.back: At a rural intersection without signals or stop slash yield signs, approach slowly and be ready for crossing traffic or an oncoming turn.
cards.memory_hook: Night work zones and rural roads

cards.front: Complete the rule: On slick winter roads, use lower speeds, gentler.
cards.back: On slick winter roads, use lower speeds, gentler braking and turns, and a larger following gap.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before winter weather, check vehicle condition and tires.
cards.back: Before winter weather, check vehicle condition and tires and have antifreeze, hoses, exhaust, battery and brakes inspected.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use oil suitable for winter.
cards.back: Use oil suitable for winter conditions and keep battery terminals clean.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At low speed, occasional gentle brake checks can.
cards.back: At low speed, occasional gentle brake checks can help assess grip and choose an appropriate speed.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid sudden hard braking on slippery pavement.
cards.back: Avoid sudden hard braking on slippery pavement because a locked wheel can worsen a skid.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Allow a substantial gap behind the.
cards.back: Allow a substantial gap behind the vehicle ahead on snow or ice.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Approach hills and bends more slowly.
cards.back: Approach hills and bends more slowly and turn the steering wheel gradually.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep windows clear and check that wipers, defroster.
cards.back: Keep windows clear and check that wipers, defroster and headlights work, with enough washer fluid available.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If stuck in snow, avoid spinning the wheels, keep.
cards.back: If stuck in snow, avoid spinning the wheels, keep them near straight, clear snow around them and use traction mats, sand or cat litter.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The winter-stranding guidance advises staying.
cards.back: The winter-stranding guidance advises staying with the vehicle while awaiting help.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a winter-stranded vehicle, display a red flag.
cards.back: For a winter-stranded vehicle, display a red flag and, if available, warning flares in front and behind.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use blankets or available warm clothing for.
cards.back: Use blankets or available warm clothing for yourself and passengers while awaiting winter assistance.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual warns to keep snow clear.
cards.back: The manual warns to keep snow clear of the exhaust outlet to reduce carbon-monoxide danger.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The suggested winter kit includes a shovel, ice scraper.
cards.back: The suggested winter kit includes a shovel, ice scraper, sand, jumper cables, warm clothes and footwear, plus flares and a red flag.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Drivers of vehicles weighing less than ten thousand pounds.
cards.back: Drivers of vehicles weighing less than ten thousand pounds must take reasonable measures to keep snow or ice from falling off while driving.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid driving in fog when possible; if travel is.
cards.back: Avoid driving in fog when possible; if travel is necessary, slow enough to stop within the distance you can see.

cards.front: Complete the rule: In fog, use low-beam headlights.
cards.back: In fog, use low-beam headlights and road-edge markings for guidance.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If fog makes visibility extremely poor, leave the.
cards.back: If fog makes visibility extremely poor, leave the road, stop with emergency flashers and wait for improvement.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On wet roads, reduce speed, allow more stopping room.
cards.back: On wet roads, reduce speed, allow more stopping room and avoid sharp turns that can trigger a skid.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The start of light rain can be.
cards.back: The start of light rain can be particularly slick as road oil mixes with water.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Maintain wipers and defroster and use headlights so.
cards.back: Maintain wipers and defroster and use headlights so you can see and be seen in rain.

cards.front: Complete the rule: In rain, signal turns and begin.
cards.back: In rain, signal turns and begin slowing early to give following drivers notice.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Hydroplaning occurs when tires ride on a.
cards.back: Hydroplaning occurs when tires ride on a water film instead of maintaining road contact.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reduce hydroplaning risk by slowing in rain.
cards.back: Reduce hydroplaning risk by slowing in rain, replacing worn tires and maintaining proper inflation.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not attempt to.
cards.back: Do not attempt to drive through a flooded roadway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Floodwater can conceal an eroded or missing road.
cards.back: Floodwater can conceal an eroded or missing road, with the danger harder to recognize after dark.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If the vehicle stalls in a flooded roadway, the.
cards.back: If the vehicle stalls in a flooded roadway, the manual directs leaving it promptly and seeking higher ground.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use extra caution and lower speed.
cards.back: Use extra caution and lower speed at night because darkness restricts visibility.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Wildlife collisions can happen throughout the year.
cards.back: Wildlife collisions can happen throughout the year, even though the manual describes seasonal peaks.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The pinned manual describes deer-collision increases.
cards.back: The pinned manual describes deer-collision increases in autumn with a November peak.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The manual identifies May and June as.
cards.back: The manual identifies May and June as peak moose-collision months and notes autumn incidents too.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At night, look for reflected deer eyes and the.
cards.back: At night, look for reflected deer eyes and the outline of a moose, whose greater height can hide its eye reflection from headlights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Be especially watchful for moose and deer from dusk.
cards.back: Be especially watchful for moose and deer from dusk to dawn, while remembering an encounter can occur at any hour.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Moose and deer signs mark places with.
cards.back: Moose and deer signs mark places with concentrated wildlife or a history of collisions.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After one deer or moose crosses, watch for.
cards.back: After one deer or moose crosses, watch for others because these animals often move in groups.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a moose near or on the road, slow.
cards.back: For a moose near or on the road, slow, remain in the vehicle and allow room and time for it to leave.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive around a moose or.
cards.back: Do not drive around a moose or get out to watch or chase it away.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If impact with an animal is imminent, the.
cards.back: If impact with an animal is imminent, the initial guidance is to brake and keep steering straight.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A passenger-vehicle load must not project beyond the left.
cards.back: A passenger-vehicle load must not project beyond the left fenders or more than six inches beyond the right fenders.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive with passengers or a load blocking.
cards.back: Do not drive with passengers or a load blocking forward or side vision or interfering with control use.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passengers must not sit on the hood.
cards.back: Passengers must not sit on the hood, roof or trunk of a moving vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: While a vehicle moves on a highway, people may.
cards.back: While a vehicle moves on a highway, people may not ride in its trunk or in a camp trailer, mobile home, semitrailer or utility trailer.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pickup passengers younger than nineteen must use the passenger.
cards.back: Pickup passengers younger than nineteen must use the passenger compartment, except qualifying work or training travel, licensed-hunter travel to or from hunting, parade participation, or a belted manufacturer-installed outside seat.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a public way, an open vehicle must secure.
cards.back: On a public way, an open vehicle must secure a dog against falling, jumping or being thrown out, except qualifying farmer or farm-employee agricultural work needing the dog, a hunting dog at a hunting site, or licensed-hunter transport between hunting sites.
